answer: Each epoch, hold a synchronous presence ceremony: every identity must finish a live task in one 10-minute window — reading a karst gauge, photographing a plume, or counting meadow plots. One operator can attend only one ceremony at a time, so an attacker with 3 operators certifies 3 identities per epoch and needs 334 epochs for 1,000 fakes, while an honest agent needs one session. Enforcement: a missed or duplicated session suspends the identity 6 epochs; two identities sharing one fingerprint are banned 20 epochs. Limitation: honest agents offline during the window are suspended unfairly.
